hypotheses.statement: Let $N\subset M$ be a unital inclusion of von Neumann algebras with separable preduals, and suppose that there is a faithful normal conditional expectation $E_N:M\to N$.

Under the hypotheses of Theorem 1, there is a maximal abelian subalgebra $A\subset N$ with a faithful normal conditional expectation $F:N\to A$ such that $$A'\cap c(M)=c(A)\vee\bigl(N'\cap c(M)\bigr).$$
For every type $\mathrm{III}_1$ factor $N$ with separable predual and every faithful normal state $\varphi$ on $N$, one has $\mathrm B(N,\varphi)=\mathbb C1$.

The expectations satisfy $$E_N|_B=\varphi(\cdot)1,\qquad E_B|_N=\varphi(\cdot)1.$$ Consequently the maps $$R(x\Omega\otimes a\Omega)=xa\Omega,\qquad
 L(x\Omega\otimes a\Omega)=ax\Omega
 \qquad(x\in N,\ a\in B)$$ extend to isometries from $H\otimes K$ to $\mathcal H$.
For the operators in [eq:UD], one has $U=D$.
If $N$ is a type $\mathrm{III}_1$ factor, then $$\mathrm B(N\subset c(M),\varphi)^\gamma=N'\cap c(M).$$

evidence.quote: Let $N\subset M$ be a unital inclusion of von Neumann algebras with separable preduals, and suppose that there is a faithful normal conditional expectation $E_N:M\to N$. There exist a unital amenable von Neumann subalgebra $P\subset N$ and a faithful normal conditional expectation $F:N\to P$ such that $$P'\cap c(M)=N'\cap c(M).$$ Here amenable means injective.
